p0_findings.title: Failure-Patch pre-access evidence is self-attested
p0_findings.description: The input spec supplies both the Failure-Patch stream and its receipt. The receipt only asserts pre_access/development_only/non-claim-bearing Booleans and hashes the same stream. Neither accepted_prior_evidence nor another controller-frozen requirement binds the receipt or stream SHA256, an authorization time, an authoritative access ledger, evaluator identity, or chronology. A caller can therefore handwrite arbitrary post hoc statistics and a matching receipt and still publish a controller-validator-passing Failure-Patch assignment once parameters are unblocked.

p1_findings.title: Paper atomic-unit formula understates the ledger descendant set
p1_findings.description: The report defines D(q) as selected six-camera and LIDAR_TOP records, while the implementation and frozen row contract include every sample_data descendant. The paper-facing definition must match the implemented all-sample_data ledger and separately describe the selected physical-file inventory.

p1_findings.title: Official split and CAN provenance remain dependent on later external acceptance
p1_findings.description: The producer hashes supplied devkit source bytes and explicit CAN rows but does not independently derive the split mapping from those bytes or authenticate each CAN-to-log association. A later N0 freeze must bind authoritative split and CAN provenance identities explicitly; they cannot be inferred from the producer's self-consistency alone.
